lines.text: David flees from Naioth in Ramah to Jonathan and says there is but a step between him and death.
David plans to hide in the field until the third evening and says to tell Saul he went to Bethlehem.
Jonathan tells David to wait beside the well of Bethlehem and says he will shoot three arrows to its side.
At the New Moon meal Saul sits beside Abner, and on day two he asks Jonathan why David is absent.
Saul hurls his sword at Jonathan, who leaves the table in fierce anger and eats nothing that day.
